task: Initial-settings Japanese residue root-cause and pipeline-boundary audit

verdict.summary: The initial-settings UI is compiled into DATA/sys/main.dol, which the text catalog and 655-file runtime staging never included. Additional definite omissions exist in the Wii HOME overlay and 23 end-roll dialogue textures.

visible_japanese_examples: 使用するコントローラを設定します

catalog.structural_reason_main_dol_was_dropped: Catalog source_root is DATA/files; main.dol resides in sibling DATA/sys.

root_cause: text_probe_10 found 1,885 EUC-JP candidates directly in DATA/sys/main.dol, including the exact initial-settings strings visible at runtime.
text_catalog_v2 was built only from DATA/files and therefore cannot carry executable-resident strings forward.
final_runtime_staging is an allowlist derived from the catalog/application/image lanes; it contains neither sys/main.dol nor Hbm nor standalone Event/endroll WTM dialogue frames.
The image audit treated 48 assets but did not inventory the Wii HOME U8 archive or the ending-dialogue standalone WTM sequence.

coverage_delta.provisional_reason: SFD video frames and opening.bnr graphics still require a complete visual sweep; the DOL probe also has untriaged candidates beyond the confirmed minimum.

checked_not_definite_or_not_japanese.conclusion: No Japanese text in the populated IMET name; not a definite Japanese-text gap. Compressed banner/icon graphics remain in the visual-sweep backlog.
Stylized Latin FIN only; not Japanese text.
Symbolic HOME icon; no text found in visual inspection.
CRIWARE logo; no Japanese localization target.

unresolved_visual_sweep: All Movie/*.sfd streams must be sampled at scene changes/end cards to prove that no Japanese text is burned into video frames.
opening.bnr banner.bin/icon.bin compressed graphics should be rendered once; its IMET text alone is not a complete graphic proof.
All remaining standalone/embedded TPL/WTM/BRRES text-bearing assets outside the 48-item image lane need contact-sheet review rather than extension-based exclusion.

remediation_recommendations_without_tran.action: Add an executable-string lane keyed to the exact source hash. Preserve printf tokens/control bytes. Verify each source byte span before patching. Where Korean codebook bytes exceed the NUL capacity, relocate rodata and patch validated pointers/callsites rather than overwriting adjacent data.
remediation_recommendations_without_tran.staging: Add a hash-bound /sys/main.dol replacement rule (or the loader-specific equivalent) and validate actual runtime interception; DATA/files rules cannot cover it.

remediation_recommendations_without_tran.action: Translate only the Japanese first column with the Codex internal model; preserve UTF-16BE BOM, CRLF, quote/tab structure, row count and all other language columns. Re-run a TSV/CSV parse and HOME overlay runtime test.

Rebuild the Nintendo U8 archive with Korean replacements for the 18 same-dimension I4 text textures. Inject/rebuild the BRFNT CMAP/glyph data for every Hangul character used by the CSV prompts; the original font maps zero Hangul syllables.
Translate and typeset all 23 ending-dialogue frames at the original canvas dimensions and GX/palette formats, then replace the physical WTM files and validate the complete ending playback sequence.

Expand source roots from DATA/files-only to explicit files+sys+banner/media lanes. Fail the build when a known user-visible physical path has no catalog/reinsertion decision. Recompute manifest counts from the final allowlist rather than hand-maintaining 655.

required_runtime_acceptance: Cold boot: strap/title/controller-selection/initial-settings screen show no Japanese.
Every initial-settings row/value/help line and controller-change confirmation is Korean with no overflow or missing glyphs.
Press HOME in a save-enabled and no-save context: all baked buttons/headings and all CSV prompts render Korean; reconnect flow and ①/② symbols remain intact.
Trigger load/save/no-space/NAND-error flows and verify all executable-resident prompts.
Play the ending through all 23 dialogue frames and verify Korean text, timing, alpha/palette and clipping.
Re-run static hashes/structure checks and publish the updated physical-file manifest before any completion claim.
